subject: Biotechnology
title: Pathway Optimization with AI
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Pathway Optimization with AI.

hook.text: Design-Build-Test-Learn — AI accelerates this cycle from months to days by predicting which designs will work.

buildup.text: Machine learning models trained on metabolic data predict enzyme combinations that maximize product yield.

discovery.text: Automated robotic foundries build and test thousands of strain variants per week — data feeds back into AI models.

twist.text: Biology is nonlinear — AI models must account for epistasis, where gene interactions defy simple prediction.

climax.text: Ginkgo Bioworks and Zymergen built AI-driven biofoundries — designing organisms at industrial scale and speed.

punchline.text: AI designs, robots build, biology executes — the factory of the future programs life.

quiz.question: What is a biofoundry?
options: A greenhouse that grows genetically modified plants
An automated facility that designs, builds, and tests engineered organisms at scale using robotics and AI
A database of all known biological pathways
